description: List an app's recent deploys, newest first, with status and commit info. Find a deployId here to pass to vibekit_rollback_deploy.
name: vibekit_list_deploys

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Array of past deploys with timestamps and commit info.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit List Deploys
